maria_sec: Heads-up — KMS key rotation kicked off in prod this morning for artifact-crypto-key. CI SAST jobs started failing with decryption timeouts around 08:03 UTC, anyone seeing the same?
jon_infra: yup, nightly pipelines show bunch of failures. Runner logs: `error: decrypt failed: AccessDeniedException` then timeouts.
alex_dev: saw similar in the gha-runner logs: `decryption failed: KMS_UNKNOWN_KEY` for /tmp/scanner-cache.tar.gz. Affected ~3 parallel runners.
sre-bot: deploy-bot: rotation event applied: kms-key-rot-2026 on 2026-03-23T08:01:12Z, scope=project-artifacts (metadata id=f9a3).
leah_prodsec: Do we have audit logs for the key grant/change? Need to confirm whether the scanner's service account lost decrypt permission during key swap.
jon_infra: checking cloud audit — there are 2 GrantKeyRole events at 08:01:10 and 08:01:11 but also a DeleteAlias event just before. Might be alias flip race.
maria_sec: if alias flip happened before re-grant, scanners would attempt decryption against old key id -> AccessDenied/UnknownKey. We should avoid alias swap until consumers refreshed.
alex_dev: quick workaround: we can requeue failing jobs with `--skip-cache` so they fetch fresh artifacts encrypted with the new key, but that increases tokenization/time. Command I used locally: `cictl rerun --job 9832 --env SKIP_CACHE=1`.
leah_prodsec: Also want to make sure audit logs capture which runner attempted decrypt and which key id failed. Can someone paste the error snippet from runner with key id?
jon_infra: log snippet: ```2026-03-23T08:03:24Z runner-17 decrypt artifact s3://artifacts/proj/1234::kmsKeyId=arn:cloud:kms:region:acct:key/abcd-OLDKEY error=AccessDeniedException```
maria_sec: that confirms OLDKEY referenced. Proposal: rollback alias flip for artifact key to preserve availability while we coordinate a safe rekey plan.
alex_dev: rolling rollback possible? That means re-encrypting anything that flipped already?
jon_infra: rollback alias is fast, we can point alias back to OLDKEY immediately. But artifacts already uploaded with NEWKEY won't be decryptable after rollback; need to re-encrypt or re-upload those. For short window, most artifacts are read-only so pointing alias back restores reads.
leah_prodsec: Another durable fix: standardize a two-step rotation: 1) grant decrypt to both old/new keys to service accounts, 2) wait 5m for consumers to refresh caches, 3) flip alias, 4) revoke old-key grants after verification. Add this into key-rotation playbook.
maria_sec: agreed. Also add CI scanners to the rotation checklist: make sure SAST/DAST service accounts are included in the pre-grant step, and that runner token caches are invalidated gracefully.
alex_dev: short-term patch: add exponential backoff + KMS-unknown-key retry in the artifact fetcher (3 retries with jitter). I'll open a tiny PR.
sre-bot: incident-tracker: new incident created #INC-2026-112 by maria_sec — "KMS rotation caused CI SAST decryption failures". Severity=P2.
jon_infra: action items: 1) roll alias back (i'll do it now), 2) requeue failed jobs with skip-cache (team leads), 3) update key rotation runbook (maria + leah), 4) small runner retry patch (alex).
maria_sec: thanks — if anyone notices other services affected (e2e, model-artifacts), ping here. I'll attach audit snippets to the incident.
leah_prodsec: I'll follow up with a compliance note for the rotation and capture the exact grant timestamps. Also will propose a CI healthcheck that runs a sample decrypt before exposing rotation to all projects.
alex_dev: PR filed: github.com/redwood/runner/compare/patch-kms-retry (draft).
jon_infra: alias rollback complete at 08:16 UTC. CI queued some reruns; monitoring now.
maria_sec: monitoring looks better; dropping to postmortem prep. We'll add short retro and update the runbook. :thumbsup:
leah_prodsec: Thanks everyone. I'll add the two-step pre-grant flow to the rotation doc and include a checklist for scanners.
maria_sec: closing thread — will update incident with remediation and next steps.
